name: JingKong v1.0.3
body:
修复窗口大圆角被外部工具清掉后不再恢复、副屏上顶部控制栏唤不出也拖不动、首帧窗口尺寸抖动三个问题。

Fixes: window silhouette (rounded corners) now self-heals within 1s when an external tool clears the window region; the top hover bar follows the owner by device pixels so it works across monitors with different DPI; the first-frame window resize loop is suppressed.
